70. Control of hotels etc.—

—   No place within the jurisdiction of a Panchayat shall be 
used as a hotel, restaurant, eating house, coffee house, sweetmeat shop, bakery, boarding 
house or lodging house (other than a hostel recognized by the Government), or a 
dharmashala or for manufacturing ice or aerated water except under a licence granted or 
renewed by the Panchayat and except in accordance with condition specified therein.
